<translate>
'''Potential Unlock''' raises the maximum '''Power Release''' you can reach by charging ki, and makes releasing faster. Every character starts with a 50% limit; ten levels bought from masters take it to 100%, and Grand Elder Guru on Namek can unlock you further, up to 115%. Level 10 is also required for Old Kai's Ultimate Challenge.
</translate>

<translate>
== Power Release ==
</translate>
{{Main|Stats and Attributes}}
<translate>
Power Release is the percentage of your power you are currently channeling. Charging ki (hold {{Key|C}}) raises it up to your maximum, and it acts as a multiplier on your melee, strike and ki damage, your defense, your speed and your Battle Power. Double-tapping {{Key|C}} jumps straight to your maximum, paying 1% of your max Ki for every 5% of release gained.

Your maximum starts at '''50%''' and each level of Potential Unlock adds '''+5%'''. [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan|Saiyans]] can push the limit further with their Limitless Power racial skill.
</translate>

<translate>
[[Special:MyLanguage/King Kai|King Kai]] requires Good alignment and Frieza Evil alignment to train you; Vegeta and Piccolo have no alignment requirement.
</translate>

<translate>
== Grand Elder Guru ==

Level 11 can't be bought with TP. Visit [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder Guru|Grand Elder Guru]] at the Grand Elder's House on [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]] and pick his '''Unlock Potential''' service: it raises Potential Unlock from level 10 to 11 if your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] is 50 or higher (below 50 he greets you coldly). After that, levels 12 and 13 can be bought again.
</translate>

<translate>
== Ultimate ==

Potential Unlock level 10 is required for [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]]'s Ultimate Challenge (alignment 62 or higher), which unlocks the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ultimate|Ultimate]] stack form and gives you the [[Special:MyLanguage/Z Sword|Z Sword]] the first time. The Buu Saga quest ''The Z Sword and Ultimate Power'' also needs Potential Unlock 10. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|Training Minigames]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]].
</translate>
